name: interactive-audit-scorecard
title: Interactive Audit Scorecard
description: Core Web Vitals scorecard grid displaying 100/100 performance grades for Performance, Accessibility, and Best Practices.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Audit Score Inspection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
